description: Read a worker's own final report. The overview and the wait response clip the last message; this is the door for the actual conclusion. Returns the last N agent messages (each clipped past maxChars, default 6000 bytes, with truncated: true and the full size so you can re-read it whole), the status fields that tell a real finish from a crash, verification (the commands the worker ran, their exit codes and the tail of any failing output, to hold its report against), acceptance (the supervisor's own run of the dispatch-time acceptance commands, independent of the report: configured, passed, and each check's exit code and output tail; passed: false means resume the worker with that output instead of reading its report, passed: true against a report that says blocked or not done means trust the checks and read the diff), changed_file_count, and base_behind (how many commits the project's HEAD is past the worktree's base; resume with rebaseOnto when it is not 0). includeFiles: true adds the changed_files list; get_worker_diff is the ground truth for what changed.
name: get_worker_result
title: Get worker result
